recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: karl the fog swallowing san francisco on a summer night
offshore wind turbines paused mid-build on a gray horizon
bulldozers threading through big bend canyon at dusk
watchdogs recounting the math on digital savings claims
record fines reshaping how platforms guard young users
three nations signing a new defence pact under desert skies

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Steer a tiny signal drone through Karl the Fog, snatching fading pings before they dissolve into the gray.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: drag to steer through thickening fog banks
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each ping fills a sunrise progress ring — one clean run clears the board before dawn
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog density rises, pings spawn faster and drift unpredictably
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: monochrome fog field with neon ping dots and soft bloom

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Release frozen offshore turbine blades in rhythm so they spin up together when the wind finally returns.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap on beat to unlatch each blade segment
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: perfect sync triggers a satisfying turbine spin-up cascade in under a minute
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: gust patterns accelerate and introduce off-beat fake cues
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor seascape at dusk with ink-wash turbine silhouettes

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw shortcut paths between phone icons to spawn agents that ship a micro-feature before sunrise.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to connect icon nodes into a single route
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: watching tiny agents race your drawn path and merge at a ship button in 30 seconds
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more nodes appear mid-run and dead-end icons block naive routes
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout iOS home screen with hand-sketched connector lines

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Lane-switch through a narrowing Big Bend canyon while flicking pebbles to bridge gaps ahead of a rumbling bulldozer.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe to change lanes, flick upward to skip chasms
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: near-misses with the dust wall feel tense; clearing the canyon in one run is pure relief
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: canyon walls close in and bulldozer speed ramps each segment
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: rust-red desert rock strata with dust particle trails and heat shimmer
